Name: The Angry Hand of God
Overview:
God is pissed and so he decided to destroy four human cities. The player controls his hand and rains down lighting with a button press. Contrary to the rumours, god's power is not limitless: each shot drains from his overall lighting power and when all is gone, the level is over. To beat a level, at least 80% of the overall value needs to be destroyed.

By holding the button longer, god can also emit middle and strong lightning bolts (which drain more energy). This is necessary, because certain items react differently to the lightning. For example, most buildings require a strong zap to be destroyed while vehicles and elephants become out of control after a middle one. Additional items to look out for are water-holding structures (splatting water on other buildings or people makes them become conductors), transformers (give back power when destroyed) and exploding items (blast damage). On the other hand, lightning rods are god's biggest enemy because they absorb the charge. Killing the pope gives negative points.

Because of the limited available energy, this is a puzzle game: the player needs to find out the correct steps to beat the four levels.
